headline.title: We searched "pelvic floor physical therapy Minneapolis". Arlo appeared in none of the 17 results.
headline.detail: Mayo Clinic, Luna's home physical therapy, an Edina pelvic specialist and several other clinics took the page. Patients looking for exactly what you do never meet you.

summary: Arlo has 21 five-star reviews describing life-changing pelvic floor, pregnancy and hypermobility care, plus something almost no competitor offers: Sunday appointments. But in our search for pelvic floor physical therapy in Minneapolis, you didn't appear at all.

gaps.title: Searchers find Mayo or an app first
gaps.detail: Someone ready to book pelvic floor PT sees a hospital or a home-visit app and chooses one of them.

gaps.title: Sunday hours go unseen
gaps.detail: Working parents who can only come at weekends don't know that you are open on Sundays.

gaps.title: Your specialisms aren't searchable
gaps.detail: Hypermobility and EDS patients search for those words; nothing of yours appears for them.

actions.title: Create a clear pelvic floor page for Minneapolis
actions.why: Patients search by need. A focused page with your Sunday hours gives them a reason to choose you.

actions.title: Ask every patient for a review automatically
actions.why: Moving from 21 towards 75 puts you level with the specialists who now appear first.

actions.title: Show your Sunday hours everywhere you're listed
actions.why: Doable today: it's your clearest advantage over weekday-only clinics.

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your team, specialties and reviews on one page, with one-tap booking from any phone.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each visit, so happy patients become five-star reviews.

plan.title: Reminders and recall
plan.detail: Follow-up and maintenance reminders that go out by themselves.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Where you stand against nearby clinics, and what to do next.

scenario: A woman in Northeast Minneapolis, 30 weeks pregnant, wants pelvic floor help but can only come at weekends. On Saturday night she searches "pelvic floor physical therapy Minneapolis", sees Mayo and weekday clinics, and gives up until after the birth. Arlo's Sunday slot, ten minutes away, stays empty.
